verified: Only the bed head is captured as new wall print; no workstation meshes are copied into the panorama
Entry starts at the foreground monitor already present in SeaMidpoint/Faces/nz.png
Bed uses the shared Sleep cursor and original interaction outline, with no left-click text prompt
Looking away rejects interaction; looking at the bed accepts the normal E interaction
Complete endings, pause and save restore, retries and room cleanup pass
Live playback changes heave during the real ten-second sky hold
Heave uses the smoothed loudness envelope of OceanWaves.wav at AudioSource.timeSamples; up to 10 cm, 2.6 degree pitch and 1.2 degree roll, blended in over 1.1 seconds
Pause freezes the view; checkpoints store the displayed PCM sample and restore the exact floating pose immediately despite asynchronous streaming seeks
Tools/SeaDreamCapture/bake_ocean_float.py reproduces the checked-in envelope byte for byte
First 0.75 seconds rotate in place with zero translation or descent, ending with the pillow behind the gaze
Only after turning does the camera move backward to the pillow and tilt upward; horizontal approach direction is derived from the saved interaction start, including side approaches
The final recline frames join the sky hold with less than 3 degrees of rotation per frame, avoiding a 180-degree sky flip
The foreground printed monitor plays the normal PCNoise recording only within a central 15-degree viewing cone; look-in fades over 0.08 seconds, look-away stops immediately
Computer noise is suppressed during black transitions, pause, menu, failure, cleanup and the exterior; camera entry and checkpoint resume use the actual camera pose
Gaze changes preserve music and ocean clip identities, source volumes and continuous sample progress without restart events
Final base camera forward is world up and image up is the bed/pillow-wall direction, independent of left, front or right approach; the heading settles continuously during recline
Default heave, pitch and roll are each doubled in both profile defaults and the shipped asset; audio cursor seeks demonstrate more than 14 cm peak-to-trough heave
The opaque room remains unchanged while walking; during recline it becomes a transparent image overlay composited over the already-rendered exterior, with no sudden reveal of closer exterior props
Ocean heave, pitch and roll default to 0.1 m, 2.6 degrees and 1.2 degrees; profile ranges and runtime limits have been raised to permit the full requested increase
The original printed scene is fully retained while the camera still looks toward the horizon; no exterior layer is rendered until the camera is at least 82 degrees upward

Approach stays inside the wall and above the bed rails during the sky-only blend; after the blend finishes the eye crosses and lowers to the true pillow, so exterior computer piles are not introduced during head tilt
The first mixed frame was also rendered at 1468x766, both with the print and with only the exterior, and visually checked to contain sky without computer piles or rails
